input.purpose: Measure the served air volume V_lab of the Lab from the occupant-CO2 rise and scrubber-driven concentration decay.
hypotheses: The Lab is a single well-mixed zone during both phases.
The closed /habitat/lab/hatch-1-v9 remains in one position throughout; exchange through it is not measured and is small enough not to dominate the fitted Lab decay.
FE-1, FE-2, and FE-3 remain in the Lab at steady activity throughout, so the occupant CO2 source is stable.
The scrubber effective flow follows its known full-speed flow and the commanded speed sufficiently for V_lab = Qe * tau.
A material correlated change in Hab-B CO2 would falsify the negligible inter-zone exchange hypothesis and invalidate the single-zone fit.

monitoring.reason: The test intentionally raises CO2 in the occupied Lab; stop on an out-of-band vital sign, monitoring loss, or occupancy change.

steps.why: Raise Lab CO2 several hundred ppm above the 1250 ppm start while using more removal and a shorter rise than the aborted test; record Lab and Hab-B CO2 each minute.
Return to full speed, record both zones each minute, and fit C(t)=C_eq+(C_0-C_eq) exp(-t/tau); calculate V_lab=Qe*tau.

abort.when: Lab CO2 is at or above 3000 ppm.
The scrubber refuses either commanded speed.
Scrubber battery state of charge is below 35 percent.
Any monitored Lab subject is outside 45-120 bpm, monitoring is lost, or any person enters or leaves the Lab.

expected.rise: From the measured 1250 ppm start, Lab CO2 should rise by several hundred ppm at 60 percent without reaching 2800 ppm; if it fails to rise clearly above sensor noise, the speed/source assumptions are not supported.
expected.decay: At 100 percent, Lab CO2 should decay exponentially toward a nonzero equilibrium after the scrubber response lag; fit C(t)=C_eq+(C_0-C_eq) exp(-t/tau), then report V_lab=Qe*tau.
expected.openingCheck: Hab-B CO2 should not show a material time-correlated copy of the Lab transient. If it does, reject the one-zone result because exchange through the closed hatch is material.
expected.validity: Reject the fit if occupancy or activity changes, a command is refused, the hatch position changes, the curve lacks a resolvable rise and decay, or any abort condition occurs.
